text:
- A circular lifecycle diagram with five green icons connected by arrows pointing clockwise:
  - Top icon labeled "DESIGN AND SOURCE" with a recycling symbol inside a leaf outline.
  - Right icon labeled "MAKE" with a solar panel symbol.
  - Bottom-right icon labeled "PACKAGE AND SHIP" with a globe symbol.
  - Bottom-left icon labeled "USE" with a plant symbol.
  - Left icon labeled "RECOVER" with a plug and recycling symbol.
